cells.ARKOSCOPE: Qualified official project sources, original links and publication dates. Source qualification helps identify origin; it does not prove every claim or guarantee protection from scams. [A1]
cells.LunarCrush: Social and news analytics; the official FAQ describes spam/bot filtering. This is not a directory restricted to project-owned sources. [L1]
cells.CryptoPanic: News aggregation with links, sentiment and community votes; optional custom feeds. No anti-phishing effectiveness rating established here. [C1]
cells.CoinMarketCal: Event curation, editorial scoring and supporting source evidence; not simply an unfiltered community feed. [E1]
cells.Messari: Research, diligence, asset profiles and curated news. No anti-phishing effectiveness rating established here. [M1]

cells.ARKOSCOPE: Automated refresh cycles collect qualified sources. A collected eligible publication can enter SCOPE FEED before a deeper analysis is ready; Tracker records evidence and expected signals. No delivery latency or speed advantage over competitors is guaranteed. [A1]
cells.LunarCrush: Continuous social-data processing; provider describes real-time social intelligence. No independent latency comparison performed. [L1, L2]
cells.CryptoPanic: Published refresh rates: visitor 10 minutes, registered user 5 minutes, PLUS approximately 30 seconds. These are refresh intervals, not a guaranteed source-to-reader latency. [C1]
cells.CoinMarketCal: Tracks upcoming catalysts. API freshness depends on plan: free tier delayed 24 hours, paid tiers described as approximately one minute. API terms must not be confused with website performance. [E2, E3]
cells.Messari: Provider documents real-time event monitoring, signals and alerts. No independent source-to-user latency comparison performed. [M1]

cells.ARKOSCOPE: Radar 20, Thesis, Vision Timeline, weekly report and ARKOSCOPE reading distinguish evidence, context, uncertainty and invalidation. Qualified content must exist; missing analysis is not invented. [A1, A2]
cells.LunarCrush: Social, sentiment and market metrics support research; equivalence to ARKOSCOPE's editorial thesis workflow was not established. [L1, L2]
cells.CryptoPanic: News, sentiment, voting and tracking tools; an equivalent structured thesis workflow was not verified. [C1]
cells.CoinMarketCal: Event context and impact analysis; an equivalent ongoing thesis dossier workflow was not verified. [E1, E2]
cells.Messari: Fundamental research, diligence, protocol reports and dated asset updates are documented. [M1, M2]

cells.ARKOSCOPE: Early Vision contains candidates and early-stage dossiers separate from Radar; Tracker follows inquiries, evidence, risks and expected signals. No guaranteed discovery of winners, returns or pre-publication information. [A1]
cells.LunarCrush: Trend, topic and social-momentum discovery; no equivalent dedicated early-stage dossier module verified. [L1]
cells.CryptoPanic: News and trends may surface developments; no equivalent dedicated early-stage dossier module verified. [C1]
cells.CoinMarketCal: Calendar of future crypto events and catalysts; not a promise of finding investment opportunities. [E1, E2]
cells.Messari: Fundraising data, screeners and research cover emerging projects and developments. [M1, M2]

cells.ARKOSCOPE: Application and official website in EN, FR, DE, ES and NL. Availability of individual source texts or qualified analysis can differ. [A1, A2]
cells.LunarCrush: Complete native UI/content language list not verified; do not label it English-only. [L1]
cells.CryptoPanic: News feeds explicitly include EN, DE, NL, ES, FR and other languages. The reviewed page identifies its UI language as English; feed languages and UI languages are distinct. [C1]
cells.CoinMarketCal: Complete native UI/content language list not verified; do not label it English-only. [E1]
cells.Messari: Complete native UI/content language list not verified; do not label it English-only. [M1]

cells.ARKOSCOPE: FREE includes general SCOPE FEED, provenance and the Observed Universe. The three-project limit applies only to personal SCOPE GUARD following; PRO allows up to 20 eligible projects plus research features and no ads. Belgium reference prices: €7.99/month or €59.99/year, equivalent to approximately €5.00/month with annual billing. Local Store price governs. [A1]
cells.LunarCrush: Free account available; Light is advertised at US$90/month or US$72/month billed annually. These are social-data/API product tiers, not the same scope as a mobile subscription. Taxes not confirmed. [L2]
cells.CryptoPanic: Free visitor/registered access plus paid PLUS; current PLUS price was not verifiable from the official page retrieved. [C1, C2]
cells.CoinMarketCal: Public calendar plus separate API plans. API Free is US$0; Standard is US$149 monthly or US$99/month billed annually. API fees exclude taxes unless stated; API access is not a mobile-app subscription. [E2, E3]
cells.Messari: Basic/free content and Enterprise are documented. A current numeric Enterprise price was not exposed in the official pricing page retrieved; no US$99+ claim is made. [M1]
